name: Nikola Petrović
bio:
Nikola's fascination with motorsport began during his childhood, watching Formula 1 races with his grandfather. This passion led him to pursue a degree in Mechanical Engineering, focusing on vehicle dynamics and performance. While studying, he volunteered with a local karting team, gaining hands-on experience in vehicle setup and data analysis.

His role as a Test Driver Coordinator at ART Grand Prix Academy is pivotal. Nikola excels at organizing testing schedules, managing driver feedback, and ensuring the effective communication of technical information between drivers and engineers. He is known for his meticulous attention to detail and his ability to quickly identify and resolve issues that arise during testing. Nikola's ambitious nature drives him to constantly seek ways to improve testing efficiency and contribute to the team's overall performance, leveraging his strong innovation skills to explore novel testing methodologies. His loyalty and big-picture thinking make him a valuable asset to the team, consistently looking for long-term gains and fostering a collaborative environment.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight fade on the sides
physical.description: Nikola is of average height, with a lean build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down ideas or observations.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific brand of Serbian coffee before every testing session.
